sections.title: The page you forgot
body: When protection is opt-in, every new route is public until someone remembers to add a check. One missed check is a data leak.

sections.title: Deny first, allow explicitly
body: In Kavach, routes are protected by default. You list the public ones, such as login and register, in one config file.

sections.title: Safe when you forget
body: A new page is private until made public. Forgetting fails closed, which is the right way to fail.
points: One file shows what is public
Each role has its own home page
